I would like to take 5 min to discuss Rest-SSZ, in particular the missing non-engine methods that are exposed on the engine port. Those are:
```
# Still used (according to LH)
- eth_syncing
- eth_getBlockByNumber
- eth_getBlockByHash
- eth_chainId
# used in eth1 deposit path
- eth_blockNumber
- eth_call
- eth_getLogs
# unused
- eth_getCode
- eth_sendRawTransaction
```

I would be curious if 
- Other clients need the same 4 methods?
- Are there additional methods needed/useful?
- Can we retire the eth1 deposit path?

## Glamsterdam upgrade mascot

There is a run-off between 🐻‍❄️ Polar Bear and 🦩 Flamingo,

Due to some potential funny business, several of the votes for Flamingo were removed from the tally, resulting in a TIE with Polar Bear.
If you have registered for an account with Ethereum Magicians before July 10th, you are eligible to vote in the tiebreaker contest.

Additionally, any votes found to share a registration IP address and creation date won’t be counted.

Vote now on Eth Magicians:
https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/mascot-needed-for-glamsterdam-upgrade/26008
I wanted to propose for inclusion https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/eip-8268-storage-roots-in-block-access-lists/28585

> Other clients need the same 4 methods?

lodestar only uses the authenticated engine api, deposit tracking has been removed entirely
